claims.claim: Apple's filed FY2026 Q3 Form 10-Q reports net income of $29.789B for the quarter ended June 27, 2026 and provides the filed financial statements underlying the issuer newsroom summary.
The filed 10-Q reports total gross margin of $54.770B and 50.1%, with Products gross margin 40.1% and Services gross margin 75.6% for the quarter.

Apple's 10-Q explicitly discusses 2025-2026 tariff actions and the February 20, 2026 U.S. Supreme Court ruling striking down certain IEEPA tariffs, providing a materially different regulatory/operating-risk source from the prior newsroom release.

risks.risk: Tariff policy and reciprocal measures remain an operating and supply-chain uncertainty; the filing discusses these measures but does not establish a stable long-run tariff regime.

contradictions.contradiction: Very strong reported gross-margin performance coexists with tariff-related policy volatility and previously disclosed temporary tariff-refund benefits, so recurring margin quality requires Alpha normalization rather than headline extrapolation.

unknowns.unknown: This Scout assist does not construct Alpha numeric underwriting, score-risk, valuation, or data-confidence judgments.
The filing does not by itself establish the durability of current tariff treatment or quantify future policy changes.
